caseName: Gallagher v. Florida East Coast Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Peter Gallagher, Administrator, etc., in Error v. Florida East Coast Railway Company
summary: In error to the District Court of the United States for the Southern District of New York.
attorneys: Mr. WilUam A. McQuaid for the plaintiff in error. Mr. George S. Scofield for the defendant in. error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction, on the authority of Fore River Shipbuilding Company v. Hagg, 219 U. S. 175; Bogart v. Southern Pacific Company, 228 U. S. 137, 144, and cases cited.
